summary: CRT process-exit/termination handler. Runs a pre-exit cleanup (sub_589D6B), then when the terminate-on-exit flag dword_8D3EB0 equals 1 force-terminates via TerminateProcess. Records the exit state (dword_8D3EAC = 1, byte_8D3EA8 = a3), and when a2 is zero runs the registered atexit function stack (top dword_8D5A50 down to bottom dword_8D5A54) plus a terminate-data-range cleanup via UtilityFunction_9d7d. An unconditional second UtilityFunction_9d7d pass covers the terminate-handler data range. When a3 is zero, marks dword_8D3EB0 = 1 and exits via ExitProcess. Returns CriticalSectionLeave().

local_names.uExitCode: process exit code forwarded to TerminateProcess/ExitProcess
local_names.a2: flag gating the atexit stack walk and terminate-data cleanup
local_names.a3: gate flag stored into byte_8D3EA8; zero also selects the ExitProcess path
local_names.v4: walker over the registered exit-function stack

operations.description: Run the pre-exit cleanup routine sub_589D6B before any exit decision.
When the terminate-on-exit flag dword_8D3EB0 equals 1, hard-terminate the process.
Obtain the current process handle via GetCurrentProcess.
Force-terminate the process with TerminateProcess(handle, uExitCode).
Record that the application is exiting: dword_8D3EAC = 1.
Store the gate flag a3 into byte_8D3EA8.
When a2 is zero, run the registered exit handlers (atexit stack and terminate-data cleanup); otherwise skip that block.
Guard the atexit stack walk: proceed only when dword_8D5A54 (stack bottom) is non-null and the stack top (dword_8D5A50 - 4) is at or above it.
Walk the registered exit-function stack from the top dword_8D5A50 down to the bottom dword_8D5A54, calling each non-null function pointer.
Clean up the terminate data range [unk_5BE3DC, unk_5BE3E4) via UtilityFunction_9d7d.
Clean up the terminate-handler data range [unk_5BE3E8, unk_5BE3F0) via UtilityFunction_9d7d (unconditional).
When the gate flag a3 is zero, mark terminate-on-exit (dword_8D3EB0 = 1) and exit normally.
Release the exit critical section via CriticalSectionLeave() and return its result.
Invoked by UtilityFunction_9ca4 and sub_589CB5 as the CRT process-exit handler.
